```{=html}
<style>
.w035 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w035 .w035-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w035 .w035-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w035 .w035-row.w035-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w035 .w035-row.w035-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w035 .w035-st { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w035 .w035-st code { font-size: 0.9em; }
.w035 .w035-tf {
  flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); font-weight: 600;
}
.w035 .w035-tf.w035-sel { border-color: #d81e2e; outline: 2px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 1px; }
.w035 .w035-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w035 button.w035-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w035 .w035-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w035 .w035-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w035 .w035-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w035 .w035-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w035 .w035-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w035 iw" id="w035">
  <div class="w035-rows" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w035-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w035-btn w035-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w035-btn w035-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w035-btn w035-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w035-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w035-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w035-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    The wall of a specific service on a specific machine can be measured in an afternoon, and beyond it timeouts appear and 503 responses replace 200s — but the shape of the curve is the same whether the demand comes from real customers or an attacker, so the metrics show only that demand exceeded capacity, never why. And pointed at a machine one neither owns nor has written permission to test, <code>ab</code> is an attack regardless of intent. See <a href="#exm-thewall">the example on the wall</a> and <a href="#sec-03-laboratory">the laboratory section</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w035');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w035-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w035-msg');
  const STATEMENTS = [
    ['The wall of a specific service on a specific machine can be measured in an afternoon.', 't'],
    ['The shape of the load curve clearly differs depending on whether the demand comes from real customers or from an attacker.', 'f'],
    ['ab -n 1000 -c 50 sends one thousand requests, fifty at a time.', 't'],
    ['Beyond the wall, 503 responses replace 200 responses and timeouts appear.', 't'],
    ['The load metrics alone can show why demand exceeded capacity.', 'f'],
    ['Pointed at a machine one neither owns nor has written permission to test, ab is an attack — regardless of intent or outcome.', 't']
  ];
  function clearMarks() {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w035-right', 'w035-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w035-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeRow(text, answer) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w035-row';
    row.dataset.a = answer;
    const st = document.createElement('div');
    st.className = 'w035-st'; st.textContent = text;
    row.appendChild(st);
    ['t', 'f'].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'w035-tf'; b.dataset.v = v;
      b.textContent = v === 't' ? 'True' : 'False';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        row.querySelectorAll('.w035-tf').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('w035-sel'));
        b.classList.add('w035-sel');
        clearMarks();
      });
      row.appendChild(b);
    });
    return row;
  }
  root.querySelector('.w035-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w035-right', 'w035-wrong');
      const sel = row.querySelector('.w035-tf.w035-sel');
      if (!sel) { open++; return; }
      if (sel.dataset.v === row.dataset.a) { row.classList.add('w035-right'); right++; }
      else { row.classList.add('w035-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === STATEMENTS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — measure the wall before someone else finds it.'; msg.className = 'w035-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (open > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + open + ' statement(s) not yet judged.'; msg.className = 'w035-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red statements are judged wrongly' + (open ? ', and ' + open + ' still open' : '') + '.'; msg.className = 'w035-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w035-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w035-tf').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w035-sel'));
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w035-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w035-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w035-right', 'w035-wrong');
      row.querySelectorAll('.w035-tf').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('w035-sel', b.dataset.v === row.dataset.a);
      });
      row.classList.add('w035-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w035-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w035-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  STATEMENTS.forEach(s => rowsBox.appendChild(makeRow(s[0], s[1])));
})();
</script>
```
